keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1650-1866: the early kingdom. Infobox 'Established: c. 1650'; 'the historic origins of the eventual kingdom of Rwanda seem to date to a period from the 14th to the 16th centuries'; 'outlying Hutu communities were subdued by Ruganzu II Ndoli in the 17th century'. The page gives no area and no outline; the Southern Province is the core around Nyanza, the researcher's reading.

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe, 1867-1896: Rwanda as today's country, after Rwabugiri's conquests ('Rwabugiri held authority from 1867 to 1895'; the Rwanda page has him 1853-95). The two pages name only Bugoyi, Bwishaza and Kingogo as annexed and give no year. The infobox gives no area; the country is 88 cells, about 22,000 km2.

ledger.note: 1897: Rwanda becomes a German protectorate. 'In 1897, Germany established a presence in Rwanda with the formation of an alliance with the king, beginning the colonial era'; infobox 'A protectorate under the German East Africa (1897-1916)'. The Rwabugiri page: Rwabugiri's death and the following coup 'opened a window for German direct colonization in 1897'.

notes:
New state (Cliopatria has the Republic of Rwanda from 1963 only). Two pages: Kingdom of Rwanda and Kigeli IV of Rwanda. Both are thin on territory: no outline, no area, no dates for the conquests (Bugoyi, Bwishaza, Kingogo named; Bugesera, Gisaka, Ndorwa, Bushi, Idjwi and Kinyaga do not appear on either page), and nothing on wars with Burundi, Ndorwa or Gisaka. The 1867 gain is a placeholder at confidence 1 (reviewer af-05 moved it from 1881 to match the keyframe).

Disagreements: Rwabugiri reigned 1853-95 (Rwanda page) or 1867-95 (Rwabugiri page); the established date c. 1650 (infobox) against origins in the 14th to 16th centuries (text); 1897 for the German presence in both pages, the first Europeans in 1894. The end year 1897 is the end of Rwandan sovereignty; the monarchy lasted to 1961.

Counterparts needing dossiers: german-africa (af-08, protectorate from 1897), the Congo Free State (af-06), Burundi's Kingdom (this batch). Gazetteer names needed: Bugoyi, Bwishaza, Kingogo, Nduga (historic provinces).
